text:
maria-support: FYI escalating a HIPAA/BAA addendum request from ClinicPath. They tried to pull an audit log export for 2025-11-02 and got a 403 from the export API. Customer says retention window in our portal shows only 30 days but BAA requires 7 years — they want official evidence and a walk-through of the export/proof-of-delivery. attaching the customer's repro below.

alex-eng: can you paste the exact request and response? need request_id, region, and the export job id so we can trace KMS/HSM ops.

maria-support: pasted from customer: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx" \n  "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/audit/exports?start=2025-11-02T00:00:00Z&end=2025-11-03T00:00:00Z"\nResponse: 403 Forbidden\n{\"error\":\"export_not_authorized\",\"message\":\"Key policy denies export\"}\nJob header: X-Export-Job: job_20251102_7a3b
Request-ID: r-0b9c4d2e
Region: us-east-1
```

matt-oncall: I'm on it, looking at the job r-0b9c4d2e in logs. Quick note: there was a config change to the export lambda's IAM role on 2025-11-01 (rollback planned but might've missed a policy). I can confirm whether KMS key policy was tightened.

auditbot: Alert: export job job_20251102_7a3b returned 403. KMS: key/redwood-audit-us-east-1 - AccessDenied on GenerateDataKey. Timestamp: 2025-11-02T02:14:12Z.

alex-eng: looks like GenerateDataKey was denied by key policy. Two possibilities: 1) customer is trying to request a cross-account export (not allowed unless key policy permits) or 2) our service principal lost kms:GenerateDataKey permission in that region after the role change. I'll check KMS key policy history and CloudTrail for PutKeyPolicy events.

jen-compliance: while you investigate, we should prepare a formal response to the customer: acknowledge receipt, confirm we're investigating and will provide (A) audit log delivery attempt records (job id + timestamps), (B) KMS event evidence (CloudTrail entries), (C) a statement of current retention policy and planned remediation steps. We also need to coordinate legal for the addendum language re: retention length — they referenced 7-year requirement.

maria-support: agreed. Draft reply to ClinicPath: "We see your export job id job_20251102_7a3b failed with a KMS permission error. We're collecting CloudTrail and key policy evidence and will follow up within 24 hours with the export retry or a secure delivery plan." Want compliance to approve wording before I send.

matt-oncall: I pulled CloudTrail entries: PutKeyPolicy event for key/redwood-audit-us-east-1 on 2025-11-01T21:07:03Z by admin@infra-deploy. The policy change removed a statement that allowed servicePrincipal: "redwood-exporter@accounts.redwood" kms:GenerateDataKey. I will re-add the statement and re-run the export in staging then replay for the customer export after approval.

alex-eng: after we re-add permission, export should succeed. Need change approved by compliance and oncall. Note: re-adding permission will allow exports for any export job in that account — we should lock to the export job role/arn. I'll prepare a minimal PutKeyPolicy diff.

jen-compliance: please draft the exact policy diff and include scope: key ARN, principal ARN for the exporter role, and expiration for the permission (temporary 48h if we want to be conservative). Also collect CloudTrail entries for GenerateDataKey failures and a signed statement from infra detailing the rollback timeline. I'll review and sign.

maria-support: timeline for customer: 1) acknowledge (within 1 hour) 2) provide initial evidence (CloudTrail + job metadata) and ETA for remediation (within 24h) 3) once policy fix is applied, re-run export and deliver via S3 presigned link + KMS-wrapped envelope, and provide signed attestation.

matt-oncall: I'm creating a PR to restore the minimal policy now (PR: infra/keys#274). I will also run a one-off export attempt and attach logs here.

auditbot: Deploy PR infra/keys#274 merged to staging at 2025-11-02T03:40:02Z. Test export attempt job_test_20251102 returned 200 OK; GenerateDataKey succeeded.

alex-eng: once PR is merged to prod and compliance approves, we should: (A) run the customer export, (B) provide CloudTrail evidence bundle + export manifest, (C) offer a separate channel for notarized delivery if they require. I'll draft the export manifest template.

jen-compliance: approved the wording for the customer reply. Maria, go ahead to send the acknowledgement and attach that we're pursuing KMS policy restoration and will follow up with the evidence package. Keep me on cc.

maria-support: Sent initial ack to ClinicPath at 2025-11-02T04:05Z. Customer replied: "Thanks — please expedite, auditor on site next week." She asked for an estimated completion window. I replied 24-48h.

matt-oncall: Prod PR merged at 2025-11-02T04:30:11Z. Re-run export job job_20251102_7a3b (internal replay). Export completed 200 OK at 2025-11-02T04:45:02Z. Generated S3 manifest: s3://redwood-exports/clinicpath/job_20251102_7a3b/manifest.json

alex-eng: packaging CloudTrail evidence: PutKeyPolicy diff, GenerateDataKey failure events, successful GenerateDataKey events post-fix, export logs (request IDs), and the S3 manifest. We'll hand to compliance for signature and to the customer as the evidence package.

jen-compliance: Approved package. I will create a signed attestation (PDF) that includes the timeline and the artifacts list. Maria, coordinate secure delivery (we use presigned S3 link + one-time passphrase over phone).

maria-support: Delivery plan executed — sent presigned link (valid 48h) and did OTP over phone. Customer confirmed receipt and will share with auditor. Ticket status -> escalated/resolved after attestation. :white_check_mark: 

matt-oncall: I also added an automated check to our deploy pipeline to prevent removing exporter principal from audit keys going forward. small infra follow-up ticket: infra/keys#275.

alex-eng: closing notes: root cause = accidental removal of exporter principal from KMS key policy during infra change. Remediation = restore minimal principal permission scoped to exporter role, add deploy guard, deliver evidence package. Recommend we publish an internal KB for handling audit export escalations.

maria-support: Thanks all — I'll close the support thread and attach the evidence bundle and attestation to the customer's ticket.
